# REMAINING_WORK

> What remains has gravity; the Awtsmoos turns gravity into clarity.

## Open
- [ ] Inventory every app with movie, animation, timeline, 2D, 3D, canvas, WebGL, or renderer capabilities.
- [ ] Trace imports, routes, saved-data formats, AI hooks, and render/runtime dependencies.
- [ ] Select the shared-core architecture from evidence.
- [ ] Identify exact files to rewrite and split.
- [ ] Implement unified movie contracts and 2D/3D backends/adapters.
- [ ] Integrate each applicable app while preserving distinct product personality.
- [ ] Build mobile-first controls and responsive stage behavior.
- [ ] Author an approximately 180-second showcase using broad engine capabilities.
- [ ] Run syntax/static tests.
- [ ] Run runtime/unit/integration tests.
- [ ] Run browser tests on real routes with console inspection.
- [ ] Verify timeline completion and scene transitions.
- [ ] Re-read all touched files and compare planned vs actual.
- [ ] Resolve discovered deltas and shadow work.
- [ ] Record final verification evidence.

## Completion gate
This file may become empty only when implementation, verification, discovered work, critical-risk review, and handoff evidence are all complete.
